question: dame, por cada país, los tres comercios que más volumen liquidan, con el país, el nombre comercial y el volumen en euros
sql: SELECT country_code, trade_name, gross_eur_minor FROM (SELECT ref_country.country_code, v_merchant_current.trade_name, fact_settlement_batch.gross_eur_minor, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ref_country.country_code ORDER BY fact_settlement_batch.gross_eur_minor DESC) as rank FROM fact_settlement_batch JOIN v_merchant_current ON fact_settlement_batch.merchant_id = v_merchant_current.merchant_id JOIN ref_country ON v_merchant_current.country_code = ref_country.country_code) WHERE rank <= 3
